highlights: Autonomous agent deployment is moving deeper into core infrastructure, highlighted by OpenAI/Cisco's Shirudo runtime defense and Anthropic's Claude Ship for PR stewardship.
Model scaling is embracing looping architectures and domain-specific post-training, showcased by Z.ai's 750B GLM-5.4 Loop Transformer and ByteDance's Laminar async RL framework.

Hardware and compiler controls are unlocking dramatic edge and datacenter gains, from Meta's TLX Triton extensions on Blackwell/AMD to AI-designed hardware architectures like Architect Labs' Frostbite CPU.

agents.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for GitHub Pull Request Review and Fixes
agents.summary: Anthropic released Claude Ship, bundling automated code review, PR stewardship, and approvals directly into GitHub workflows to autonomously review, patch, and manage code reviews.

agents.title: OpenAI and Cisco Release Shirudo for Real-Time Runtime Defense
agents.summary: Shirudo is a BSD-licensed eBPF Linux runtime allowing security agents to synthesize signed shields that block active exploit paths in real time without downtime while patches are prepared.

agents.title: SpatialCraft Enables Frozen MLLMs to Self-Evolve Spatial Reasoning Skills
agents.summary: SpatialCraft introduces an experience-and-skill orchestration framework that allows stateless MLLM agents to learn optimal multi-step tool calls from past interaction history without updating weights.

models.title: Z AI Releases GLM-5.4: A 750B Loop Transformer Architecture
models.summary: GLM-5.4 is a flagship 750B parameter Loop Transformer that executes 28 GLM-5 layers twice per forward pass, providing significantly deeper reasoning capabilities before open-weights release.

models.title: NVIDIA Releases Alpamayo 2 Edge Reasoning VLA for DRIVE Thor
models.summary: NVIDIA launched Alpamayo 2 Edge, a 2B vision-language-action reasoning model designed for DRIVE AGX Thor that plans and explains driving trajectories at 160-190ms latency.

models.title: GPT-6 Models Demonstrate Intrinsic Protein-Design Capabilities
models.summary: OpenAI highlighted GPT-6's native reasoning and code generation capabilities for designing functional protein structures and sequences, validated by wet-lab binding tests.

tools.title: ByteDance Open-Sources Laminar Asynchronous RL Post-Training Framework
tools.summary: Laminar decouples rollout, training, and weight synchronization for RL, boosting Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B to 52.2% on SWE-bench Verified through asynchronous RL training.

tools.title: Meta TLX Brings Warp-Group GPU Control to Triton Kernels
tools.summary: Meta introduced TLX, extending Triton with fine-grained warp-group, barrier, TMA, and cluster control targeting Hopper, Blackwell, and AMD MI350 architectures.

tools.title: Google Releases Tool Retrieval Preview in the Gemini API
tools.summary: The Gemini API introduced Tool Retrieval, enabling developers to expose hundreds of capabilities to agents dynamically while drastically cutting prompt token usage.

companies.title: Architect Labs Unveils Frostbite: AI-Designed Interaction Net CPU
companies.summary: Architect Labs taped out Frostbite, an AI-designed 7nm CPU running interaction nets in hardware that demonstrates a 4.59x performance-per-watt advantage over standard in-order cores.

companies.title: Google and Adobe Announce Deep Creative & Workspace AI Integrations
companies.summary: Google and Adobe partnered to bring native Adobe creative and PDF tools into Google Drive and embed Adobe generative capabilities inside the Gemini app.

companies.title: Hugging Face Partners with OpenRouter for Open-Weight Model Hosting
companies.summary: Hugging Face and OpenRouter joined forces to provide seamless one-click serverless deployment and API routing for open-weight models across global inference providers.

learning.title: Building and Maintaining Agentic Evaluation Pipelines
learning.summary: A comprehensive guide on establishing robust continuous evaluation suites specifically designed to stress-test autonomous LLM agents across complex multi-step trajectories.

learning.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
learning.summary: A practical technical guide covering dataset preparation, LoRA configurations, and optimization strategies for custom fine-tuning of 3D generative diffusion models.

learning.title: Microduck Obstacle Avoidance: Sim2Real Workflow with Isaac Lab & Newton
learning.summary: A step-by-step hands-on guide demonstrating robotics simulation-to-reality transfer using NVIDIA Isaac Lab and Newton physics environments for obstacle avoidance.
